palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same forward and backward (ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization). Here's a palindrome that is 365 characters long:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"

This sentence, when reversed, also reads "malayalam teaches Arora madam". The palindrome includes all the letters from A to M, showcasing its uniqueness while maintaining the structure of a palindrome.
